audit_findings.violation_detail: The A1R2 preparation used the six C4 minimal records (only intent, resolved_aliases, analysis_diagnostics) plus defaults: target_repositories, resolved_versions, symbols, concepts were absent and validated to empty defaults, and required_source_types=[] was hardcoded — although faithful full values for every one of these fields exist in the C3-R3 artifact for the same cases. source_budgets was additionally borrowed from a same-intent plan (policy-equivalent, benign).

invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.exact: INVALID — plan.symbols/concepts empty, terms degraded to the question-regex fallback
invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.raw_dense: INVALID — empty target_repositories removed the version/source filter (unfiltered full-index query)
invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.paper: behavior-equivalent by coincidence — both the faithful and defaulted required_source_types exclude 'paper' and the faithful paper_page_hints for these three troubleshooting cases are empty, so _paper returns [] either way
invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.workflow: INVALID — allowed_sources lack the faithful target repositories (scope differs) although the required-source gate coincides
invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.graph: INVALID — same scope difference plus seeds derived from the already-invalid exact/dense/sparse streams
invalid_channels_for_affected_cases.semantic_dense (g113): INVALID — the semantic query text (from faithful analysis_diagnostics) was correct but the same missing filter applies

audit_findings.semantic_activation_screen_impact: none — activation was derived from analysis_diagnostics, which is present and faithful in the minimal records

fail_consequences.repair_path: re-prepare the three cases' plans from the C3-R3 faithful full plans (all fields case-faithful; source_budgets from the versioned intent policy) and recapture only those three frozen cases in a separately authorized repair; no other case is affected
fail_consequences.c6_a2_execution: NOT_ELIGIBLE until the provenance violation is repaired: prerequisite condition 3 (every case uses a faithful C2-3.7 plan) fails for 3 of the 30 core cases; core remains >= 12 without them, but cohort shrinking after outcomes is prohibited, so the correct path is repair-then-recapture of the same three frozen cases
fail_consequences.c6_a1r2_historical_fields: capture results and P0 replay integrity remain valid as historical records of what was executed; the faithful-plan prerequisite is what failed
